user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join population attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the observed total population attributes to the census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the census tract GeoPackage and the population CSV using the runtime-grounded compatible tract identifier fields. Do not assume or hard-code join field names.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract land-area table
workflow_steps.purpose: Retrieve a candidate tabular dataset containing land area for Centre County census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a CSV table covering Centre County census tracts and containing a land-area attribute and a tract identifier usable for joining to the tract boundaries. Treat the result as a candidate and validate coverage and fields at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Create tract population and land-area dataset
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach land-area attributes to the population-enriched census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the population-enriched tract GeoPackage to the retrieved land-area CSV using runtime-grounded compatible tract identifier fields. Preserve the tract geometry and the population and land-area attributes. Do not assume or hard-code join field names or output field names.
